reasons: B matches rubric item 1 by presenting «льгота» as the broader, looser term and «налоговый вычет» under ст. 220 as the precise one, while A says they are legally different mechanisms. Both give the 2M/3M limits correctly and tie refunds to НДФЛ paid, and each has comparable factual slips: A invents a 3-year deadline to claim the deduction, while B wrongly says the interest deduction only starts after the main one is used up and cites an irrelevant 54-ФЗ. On balance B fits the rubric slightly better.

A: Claims the deduction must be claimed within 3 years of purchase; the right to the deduction has no time limit, only refunds for past tax years are limited to 3 years
Spousal interest figure of up to 780 000 roubles is presented as a typical doubling without noting it depends on each spouse actually paying over 3M of interest
B: States the interest deduction can only be used after the main 2M deduction is fully exhausted; both can be claimed in the same period
Cites Federal Law No. 54-FZ as relevant to НДФЛ changes; 54-ФЗ concerns cash registers
Labels the employer route as the 'упрощенный порядок', which is a separate procedure
